source: Built from Nexon's v.272 patch notes (news 47132, re-read 27 Nov 2026) and Challenger World notice, checked 21–23 Nov 2026, and MapleStory Wiki pages read 27 Nov 2026. Items marked unconfirmed have a reset pill you can switch.

items.label: Pop a 3x EXP coupon, then start the grind
items.note: Stack a 4x coupon or VIP buff if you have one.

items.label: Cernium daily: 30 Cernium symbols
items.note: Your grind block. The same kills fill event kill counters and the weekly hunts. Heroic gives 30 a day (MapleStory Wiki).

items.label: Hotel Arcus daily: 15 Arcus symbols
items.note: Opens at Lv. 265 after the Arcus questline.

items.label: Odium daily: 15 Odium symbols
items.note: Opens at Lv. 270. Daily quest: Odium Area Expedition (MapleStory Wiki, checked 23 Nov 2026).

items.label: Shangri-La daily: 15 Shangri-La symbols
items.note: Opens at Lv. 275. Daily quest: Shangri-La Contamination Purification (MapleStory Wiki, checked 23 Nov 2026).

items.label: Arteria daily: 15 Arteria symbols
items.note: Opens at Lv. 280. Daily quest: Defeat the Arteria Remnants (MapleStory Wiki, checked 23 Nov 2026).

items.label: Carcion daily: 15 Carcion symbols
items.note: Opens at Lv. 285. Daily quest: Carcion Recovery Support (MapleStory Wiki, checked 23 Nov 2026).

items.label: Ursus: one run
items.note: One run a day since v.272 (was three), with meso rewards tripled and Golden Time always on (Nexon v.272 patch notes, 10 Nov 2026; checked 23 Nov 2026). About 90M a day on Heroic is a community estimate.

items.label: Daily bosses
items.empty: Pick your daily bosses on Bosses
items.note: The daily bosses you picked on Bosses. One tick per clear: the same tick as on Bosses.

items.label: Start Luxe Sauna when you log off
items.note: Coupons only: 30 min of AFK EXP each, up to 48 h a week; the weekly limit resets Wednesday 00:00 UTC. The Sauna runs until 9 Jun 2027 08:59 KST (v.272 notes).

items.label: Claim the Ultima Supply Report coupons and Challenger rewards
items.note: Supplies collect themselves when you log in, up to 5 times a week (three 3x EXP coupons each). The coupons wait until you claim them; 15 trade for one 4x. A missed day only matters if the week ends under 5, and buying it back costs Maple Points: don't (Nexon v.272 patch notes, news 47132, read 27 Nov 2026).

items.label: Shadow Supplies activations
items.note: Each needs 500 kills near your level and summons a box of EXP. 10 are added each day you log in and up to 50 are kept, so you can save them for one long session. A day you don't log in adds none. Use them before the event ends (Nexon v.272 patch notes, news 47132, read 27 Nov 2026).

items.label: Use Arcane Seal wands
items.note: 3 wands arrive every day at 09:00 KST, even when you are offline, and up to 20 are kept. Use them at least every 6 days so none are lost (Nexon v.272 patch notes, news 47132, read 27 Nov 2026).

items.label: Spend new Training Cards
items.note: Cards come with each Defense Mission claim (5 Combat + 5 Special, up to 5 claims a week), so spend them after claiming (Nexon v.272 patch notes, news 47132, read 27 Nov 2026). Combat: Normal Enemy Damage, then Boss Damage, IED and ATT. Special: Grandis daily rewards, Monster Park clear EXP.

items.label: Gollux
items.note: Long-term source of Superior Gollux accessories. One clear a day on any difficulty: the same tick as Gollux on Bosses.

items.label: Monster Park Sweep with leftover free tickets
items.note: EXP only. The 2 free clears a day are shared by every character in the same world. Read the prompt so the Sweep doesn't spend Maple Points.

items.label: Arcane River dailies
items.note: Only while your Arcane symbols need levels and you have the mesos to fuse them.

items.label: Sunny Sunday: read the perk before spending mesos
items.note: Sunday 09:00 KST to Monday 08:59 KST. Hold big cube or Star Force spends for a discount Sunday.

items.label: Challenger World weekly progression missions
items.note: One of the three is enough: 5,000 monsters near your level, Monster Park 6 times, or 12 Symbol daily quests, then press Complete. 1,500 Challenger Coins a week at most, even with all three. Progress resets every Wednesday at 00:00 UTC (Nexon's Challenger World notice, read 27 Nov 2026).

items.label: Shadow Bounties: beat one weekly boss solo
items.note: 1-person party; Practice Mode counts. Only your best boss of the bounty week pays, so solo your hardest one. Up to 3,000 Basic, 2,000 Intermediate and 100 Advanced coins a week per world. The bounty week ends Wednesday 09:00 KST, a day before the boss reset (v.272 notes, read 27 Nov 2026).

items.label: Specter Blast
items.note: 2-player weekly EXP, once a week for the account, from Lv. 260 after the 'A Divine Power' quest. The weekly EXP limit resets Wednesday 00:00 UTC (Nexon v.272 patch notes, news 47132, read 27 Nov 2026). Skip it if matchmaking is slow.

items.label: Etherion Relics: 10,000 solo kills
items.note: Shared by the account. Kills count only while solo. One more completion opens every Wednesday 09:00 KST, up to 12, and they can all be used at once, so a skipped week is not lost. The first one also adds 4 Arcane and 3 Sacred symbols a day to each area's daily quest (Nexon v.272 patch notes, news 47132, read 27 Nov 2026).

items.label: Weekly bosses
items.note: Cleared this week out of the weekly bosses you picked. Tick clears on the Bosses page or on Today; Bosses tracks your 14-crystal cap and income.

items.label: Challenger Pass weekly missions
items.note: Up to 500 points a week; resets Thursday 00:00 UTC. From Lv. 260; points and missions are shared by your characters in this world (Nexon v.272 patch notes, news 47132, read 27 Nov 2026).

items.label: Epic Dungeon: one clear a week
items.note: One clear a week per character (3 a week per account), Thursday reset (MapleStory Wiki, Epic Dungeon pages, read 27 Nov 2026). Opens at Lv. 260 after the prerequisite quests. On Heroic: High Mountain gives EXP, Sol Erda and 50 Fragments; Angler Company (from Lv. 270, after [Odium] Hundun Laid to Rest) adds Dense Sol Erda Energy and gives 65; Nightmare Paradise (from Lv. 280, after [Arteria] The Battle's Aftermath) gives 2 Sol Erda and 80. Run the best one you can enter. Counts for the Challenger Pass weekly mission (Nexon v.272 patch notes, news 47132, read 27 Nov 2026).

items.label: Item Burning Plus hunt: 2,000 kills for 100 crests
items.note: Monsters within 20 levels. Solo weekly boss clears pay crests too: Lotus, Damien, Guardian Angel Slime, Lucid, Will, Gloom, Darknell, Verus Hilla, Kai and Mayrin give 50-200 each, and Practice Mode counts. See Progress, Item Burning. Resets Thursday 00:00 UTC (Nexon, news id 47305).

items.label: Normal Kai (mission clear)
items.note: Needed for Item Burning Plus Stage 4 and the Challenger World mission; a solo clear also gives 50 Challenge Crests. No crystal, and it does not use a weekly boss clear. Nexon lets in only characters who have not finished those missions, so it may close once both are done: check in game. Lv. 235+, solo. The same tick as Kai on Bosses (Nexon, news id 47305).

items.label: Mayrin (from Lv. 270)
items.note: Season boss, once a week per account. Golden Meso Pouches, +3% ATT soul. The same tick as Mayrin on Bosses.

items.label: Shadow Bounties shop
items.note: 4x EXP coupons (500 Basic, 2 a week), Symbol Selector Coupons (100 Basic), then Karma Bright Cubes (Heroic gets no Bonus Bright).

items.label: Arthur's Equipment Rental before a real boss attempt
items.note: Lasts 2 days, up to 3 a week, paid in mesos first.

groups.title: Reset day unconfirmed
groups.hint: tap the pill to match the in-game timer

items.label: Extreme Monster Parker: 5 Monster Park clears
items.note: From Lv. 260. Rewards can be claimed on up to 2 characters per world (Nexon v.272 patch notes, news 47132, read 27 Nov 2026). Sweep with free tickets only. Nexon does not say the reset day.

items.label: Ultima weekly hunt: 2,000 kills
items.note: 800 Alliance Credit plus Training Cards each. Progress is shared by the account. A missed week can only be bought back with Maple Points, so don't skip it (Nexon v.272 patch notes, news 47132, read 27 Nov 2026). Nexon does not say the reset day.

items.label: Arcane River weekly quests: 240 symbols per area
items.note: One completion a week per area for 240 symbols since v.272 (Nexon v.272 patch notes, news 47132, read 27 Nov 2026). Only while your Arcane symbols need levels; Progress dates count it in "Per week". Nexon does not say the reset day (Monday is the usual one for weekly quests): check the in-game timer.

items.label: Erda's Request: weekly Sol Erda quest
items.note: 9 Sol Erda a week in GMS (MapleStory Wiki, Sol Erda page, read 27 Nov 2026). The Sol Erda planner on Progress counts 9 Sol Erda and 90 Fragments a week from it; the 90 Fragments and a once-per-account limit are player reports, not confirmed. Sol Erda is for Lv. 260+ after the 6th job. Reset day not confirmed: check the in-game timer.

fieldsNote: Item fields: "optional": true (or a group with "optional": true) = shown, but never counted in the core dailies, the streak or the reset warnings; things that bank up or collect themselves belong there; "def" = the reset day used in the "Reset day unconfirmed" group until the player taps the pill; "scope": "account" = ticked once for the whole account (the item's note says so; a tick made on a character before the item became account-wide still counts for its period); "only": "challenger" = shown only for Challenger World characters (named in Nexon's Challenger World notice, id 47305, or in the item's own text); "minLevel" = locked below that level (the symbol-area dailies use the areas' unlock levels in symbols.json: Cernium 260, Arcus 265, Odium 270, Shangri-La 275, Arteria 280, Carcion 285, with the daily amounts and quest names from the same file; Mayrin 270 is in Nexon's notice; Extreme Monster Parker and Epic Dungeon 260 are in the v.272 patch notes, id 47132); "gate" = the id of a symbol area in symbols.json: the item stays locked until Progress holds a symbol level above 0 for that area or the player marks it unlocked. Gated items are listed in level order, and of those still above the character's level only the next one is shown. One record per boss clear (the ticks on the Bosses page): "bosses": "daily" or "weekly" = the row follows the bosses of that reset picked on Bosses ("empty" is its text while none is picked); "boss": [ids from bosses.json] = the row is that boss's own tick on Bosses.
